10k.note: 10-K describes commercial-stage RxSight Light Adjustable Lens system; pivotal Phase 3 study completed 2016 and Post-Approval Study accepted by FDA 2025. No active drug-development pipeline disclosed.

website.note: Commercial LAL/LAL+ intraocular lens with Light Delivery Device. No public pipeline page; no active NCT IDs disclosed.

ctgov.note: All RxSight-sponsored ClinicalTrials.gov records are completed Phase 3 pivotal or post-approval studies; no active interventional P1-P3 trials.

commercial_product.summary: RxSight is a commercial-stage ophthalmic medical-technology company.

products.name: RxSight Light Adjustable Lens (LAL / LAL+)
products.indication: Premium intraocular lens for cataract surgery patients with residual refractive error and astigmatism
products.regulatory_status: FDA PMA approved 2017-11-22; ~55 PMA supplements through 2025; CE mark and approvals in EU, Canada, Mexico, Singapore, Australia, South Korea

products.name: RxSight Light Delivery Device (LDD)
products.indication: Office-based UV light delivery system used to adjust LAL refractive properties post-implantation

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Commercial-stage ophthalmic medtech focused on the FDA-approved RxSight LAL/LDD system. R&D activities are line-extension and lifecycle management of an approved device (additional diopter powers, software/manufacturing improvements). No active P1/P2/P3 drug or device pivotal IDE study disclosed in 10-K, on corporate website, or on ClinicalTrials.gov.
